stem.text: Compound X has the empirical formula $\text{C}_2\text{H}_3\text{O}$.
Compound X reacts with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine reagent to give an orange precipitate and also decolourises warmed acidified potassium manganate(VII) solution.
What could be the identity of X?

A.alt: OHCCH2CH2CHO displayed formula: a CHO group at each end of a chain of two CH2 groups

B.alt: CH3COCOCH3 displayed formula: two C=O groups joined directly, each carbon with a CH3 group

C.alt: CH3C(COOH)=CH2 displayed formula: a C=CH2 group with CH3 and COOH on the other carbon

D.alt: HOOC(CH2)4CHO displayed formula: a chain of four CH2 groups with COOH at one end and CHO at the other
